spans.s:
kám, pcl.
 —1. emphasizing the preceding
word, 79^11;
 —2. interr. pcl., 88^10. [ka,
1111a: cf. kád, kím.]

√kamp (kámpate; cakampé; kampitá;
kámpitum; -kámpya). tremble or shake.

kambu-grīva, m. Shell-neck (i. e. having
folds in the neck like a spiral shell), name
of a tortoise. [grīvā́.]

kā́ma, m. wish, desire, longing; love; at
end of possessive cpds [1296], having desire
for…, desirous of…; kāmam, see s. v.
[√kam.]

kāma-dúh (-dhuk, -duham, -dhugbhis,
etc. [155]),
 —1. a. yielding wishes, granting
every wish;
 —2. as f., sc. dhenu, the
fabulous Wonder-cow. [for 2, cf. the
horn of Amalthēa.]

kāminī-sakha, a. in the company of
his wives. [see sakha.]
